Conversely, the return journey along the same stretch is witnessing a relatively fast-moving traffic flow.

At Alaagba, the ascent and descent of the overhead bridge inward to Iyana Ipaja Roundabout is experiencing a steady traffic movement, which is somewhat encouraging.

From Iyana Ipaja Roundabout inward Baruwa Junction through Mosalasi Roundabout, traffic is flowing smoothly, with the return journey along the same stretch, all the way to Iyana Ipaja Roundabout, also proceeding without major hindrances, albeit with a slight delay observed within Baruwa Roundabout.

Furthermore, the stretch from Mosalasi Roundabout inward to Isheri Roundabout through Egbeda Intersection is experiencing a free flow of traffic, with the return journey witnessing similar conditions, although a slight delay is noted within Egbeda Intersection.

As of the time of this report, no major impediments to traffic flow have been reported across the axis.
